title: Foundation methods doc sweep: propagate canonical to calendars-server
description:
## Scope

Propagate the canonical foundation-methods doc shape (written on
mail-server under JMAP-x2gd.86.1) to calendars-server's
`create_object` / `update_object` / `destroy_object` rustdoc.

Adapt only for extension-specific content:
- SetErrorType variants and their calendars-specific triggers
- Cascade rules that match calendars's actual reference-impl behavior
- Examples drawn from calendars's types, not mail's

The 5-contract shape stays identical to canonical mail-server:
SetErrorType selection, Some/None semantics on update, state-bump
contract, cascade rules, atomicity within multi-property updates.

## Dependency

This bead is blocked on JMAP-x2gd.86.1 (the canonical write).
Pick up only after that bead closes.
